<thought>Search for templates that, in the forward direction, break a trimethylsilyl group and a ketone (reflecting loss of Si and O) and form a C‑C double bond, which matches the Peterson reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
